This FloPlast 110mm grey double socket pipe coupler provides a reliable push-fit connection for soil and vent drainage systems. Manufactured from lightweight uPVC, it offers excellent strength and durability, making it suitable for demanding installations. Its push-fit system with ring seal joints ensures straightforward jointing, especially when using silicone lubricant on all seals. This coupler is designed for trade professionals working on various plumbing projects, including new build and renovation work, where efficient waste discharge management is crucial. It also accommodates high temperature waste discharges.
